Linh visits Bà Sâm at her porridge stall in a narrow alley.
Linh calls Duy from the porch after dinner to discuss checking official records the next day.
Linh interviews Bà Sâm about the funeral home bell and station Bốn, and Bà Sâm recounts historical details.
Linh returns home and has a meal with her mother, Bà Yên.
